basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Hydrology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department/Centre of Hydrology at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, is filling 3 Project Assistant (Technical) positions on the project "Establishing Globally Accredited NMR Facility & the Indian Honey Profiling Database under NBHM", paying Rs. 26000 - Rs. 57000 up to 31.03.2027 or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates need a Diploma (3 years) duration, or ITI with 4 years' experience, or 10th pass with 10 years' experience. Applications go by email to [email protected] by 29.11.2026, 5:00 PM, and the walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026 at 10:30 AM.

how_to_apply: Send the application by email to Prof. D. S. Arya, Principal Investigator, Hydrology, at [email protected], so that it is submitted by 29.11.2026, 5:00 PM.
Write the application on plain paper, with a detailed CV including the chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained.
Attach the CV and attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. The notice also allows these documents to be produced at the time of interview.
Attend the walk-in interview on 30/11/2026 at 10:30 AM at National Centre of Honey Authentication, IIT Roorkee.
Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification at the interview.
The notice prints the telephone number as Tel: 013325292.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Candidates must bring original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview. The appointment runs up to 31.03.2027 or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice gives one qualification line for the Project Assistant (Technical) post, with three alternatives: Diploma (3 years) duration; or ITI with 4 years' experience; or 10th pass with 10 years' experience. Candidates must ensure before appearing for the interview that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience. For discipline-specific eligibility, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.text: The notice prints no allowance, HRA or extension terms.

content_sections.text: To provide the assistance to the PI and finalizing the sampling work and other project related work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant (Technical)
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to Prof. D. S. Arya, Principal Investigator, Hydrology, at [email protected] , so that it is submitted by 29.11.2026, 5:00 PM. Write the application on plain paper, with a detailed CV including the chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Attach the CV and attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. The notice also allows these documents to be produced at the time of interview. Attend the walk-in interview on 30/11/2026 at 10:30 AM at National Centre of Honey Authentication, IIT Roorkee. Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) for verification at the interview. The notice prints the telephone number as Tel: 013325292.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice describes a walk-in interview, to be held at National Centre of Honey Authentication, IIT Roorkee on 30/11/2026 at 10:30 AM. Originals of degree/certificate and experience certificate are verified at the interview. The notice prints no other selection stage or marking scheme.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Candidates must bring original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview. The appointment runs up to 31.03.2027 or till the end of the project, whichever is earlier.
